items.title: Is meaningful privacy possible with hosted AI models?
items.raw_excerpt: I've been thinking about the privacy tradeoffs when using frontier AI models like Claude or chatgpt. Even with a VPN, providers still see prompts, and usage is tied to accounts and payment methods linked to identity in some way. I've been trying to find a way to access these models without creating provider-specific accounts tied to my identity. Ideally, through some kind of intermediary that abstracts identity and doesn't retain prompts. From a technical and economic perspective, would that kind of setup meaningfully improve privacy, or does it just shift trust? Is meaningful privacy with hosted AI fundamentally unrealistic regardless of architecture?

items.title: AI-runtime-guard – Policy enforcement layer for MCP AI agents
items.raw_excerpt:
I built this after realizing that AI agents with filesystem and shell access can delete files, leak credentials, or execute destructive commands — and there's no enforcement layer stopping them at the execution level. ai-runtime-guard is an MCP server that sits between your AI agent and your system. It enforces a policy layer before any file or shell action takes effect. No retraining, no prompt engineering, no changes to your agent or workflow. Your agent can say anything. It can only do what policy allows. What it does:
- Blocks dangerous commands (rm -rf, dd, shutdown, privilege escalation) before execution
- Gates risky commands behind human approval via a web GUI
- Simulates blast radius for wildcard operations before they run
- Creates automatic backups before destructive actions

items.raw_excerpt: 在时间序列预测研究中，一个耐人寻味的现象长期存在： 一方面，模型结构不断演进，从循环网络到 Transformer，再到频域与混合结构；另一方面，几乎所有方法在训练阶段依赖同一类损失函数，即以均方误差（MSE）为代表的点对点误差。 这使得时间序列预测在方法论层面呈现出一种隐性的停滞，即研究重心持续向模型表达能力倾斜，而对损失函数所隐含的统计假设缺乏系统反思。 点对点误差的核心假设在于，标签序列中的各时间步可被视为给定历史条件下相互独立的预测对象。然而，这一假设与时间序列数据的生成机制之间始终存在张力。 真实世界中的时间序列由随机过程演化而来，不同时间点之间存在显著的相关关系。将多步预测问题拆解为一组独立的回归任务，不可避免地为损失函数引入了结构性偏差，使模型难以学习标签序列的整体形态、相关结构以及条件依赖关系。 针对这一问题，北京大学林宙辰团队深入剖析了此类结构性偏差的成因。在此基础上，团队提出了 DistDF：一种通过联合分布对齐训练预测模型的损失函数。DistDF 的提出不仅为时间序列预测提供了一种新的损失函数设计思路，也在更一般的意义上，对序列建模中“应当优化什么”这一长期被默认的问题给出了新的回答。 论文地址：https://arxiv.org/pdf/2510.24574v1 当独立性假设被实验证伪之后 当前时间序列预测领域的主流方法普遍采用逐时间点的均方误差（MSE）作为损失函数： $$\mathcal{L}_{\text{MSE}} = \|\mathbf{y} - g_\theta(\mathbf{x})\|^2=\sum_{t=1}^\mathrm{T}\left(y_t-g_{\theta,t}(\mathbf{x})\right)$$ $$\mathcal{L}_\mathrm{MSE}$$隐式地做了独立性假设：在给定历史序列的条件下，标签序列各时间点

excerpt_i18n.en: In time series forecasting research, a thought-provoking phenomenon has long persisted: on one hand, model architectures have continuously evolved, from recurrent networks to Transformers, and further to frequency-domain and hybrid structures; on the other hand, almost all methods rely on the same class of loss functions during training, namely pointwise errors represented by mean squared error (MSE). This creates an implicit stagnation at the methodological level in time series forecasting, where research focus consistently leans toward model expressiveness, while lacking systematic reflection on the statistical assumptions embedded in loss functions. The core assumption of pointwise error is that each time step in the label sequence can be treated as an independent prediction target given historical conditions. However, there has always been tension between this assumption and the generative mechanism of time series data. Real-world time series evolve from stochastic processes, exhibiting significant correlations between different time points. Decomposing multi-step forecasting into a set of independent regression tasks inevitably introduces structural bias into the loss function, making it difficult for models to learn the overall shape, correlation structure, and conditional dependencies of the label sequence. To address this issue, the team led by Zhouchen Lin at Peking University has deeply analyzed the causes of such structural bias. Building on this, the team proposed DistDF: a loss function that trains forecasting models through joint distribution alignment. The introduction of DistDF not only provides a new design perspective for loss functions in time series forecasting but also, in a broader sense, challenges the long-defaulted question of "what should be optimized" in sequence modeling.
excerpt_i18n.es: En la investigación de predicción de series temporales, existe un fenómeno intrigante y persistente: por un lado, la estructura de los modelos evoluciona constantemente, desde redes recurrentes hasta Transformer, y luego a estructuras en el dominio de la frecuencia y mixtas; por otro lado, casi todos los métodos dependen en la fase de entrenamiento de la misma clase de funciones de pérdida, es decir, el error punto a punto representado por el error cuadrático medio (MSE). Esto hace que la predicción de series temporales presente a nivel metodológico un estancamiento implícito, donde el enfoque de investigación sigue inclinándose hacia la capacidad expresiva de los modelos, mientras que se carece de una reflexión sistemática sobre los supuestos estadísticos implícitos en las funciones de pérdida. El supuesto central del error punto a punto radica en que cada paso de tiempo en la secuencia de etiquetas puede considerarse independiente entre sí bajo condiciones históricas dadas.

In January 2026, Wan Zhiqiang, CMO of Xingji Meizu Group in China, stated at an event that the significant rise in memory prices has greatly impacted the phone business plan, and the Meizu 22 Air will be canceled from its launch schedule.

Yuanbao AI insulta a usuarios en Nochevieja, la empresa responde. 3. ¡Bug extraño de Apple! Usuarios reportan que iPhone realiza llamadas automáticas de madrugada, respuesta oficial. 4. Liu Qiangdong anuncia 5 pedidos de grandes yates, con un precio promedio de 60 millones de euros cada uno. 5. BYD se suma a préstamos de 7 años con baja tasa de interés; más de 20 marcas automotrices promueven créditos a largo plazo. 6. ¿El responsable del medio que debe indemnizar a Xiaomi con 5 millones es Li Bin? Respuesta publicada. 7. Asamblea de accionistas de Apple revela salario de Tim Cook, supera los 74 millones de dólares, sin detalles sobre teléfono plegable ni anuncio de sucesión.

items.title: 谷歌版「豆包手机」发布，GUI 操作实现跨 App 代办

Recently, Samsung's latest Galaxy S26 series has further enhanced its system-level integration with Gemini, introducing the Gemini smartphone assistant to help users automate tasks, with capabilities similar to the domestic "Doubao Phone Assistant." It is reported that users can activate Gemini at the system level by long-pressing the side key, using it as an entry point for "to-do tasks." Gemini can automatically complete multi-step operations, allowing users to continue using their phones during this time and monitor progress, intervene, or stop tasks in real-time via the notification bar. It is understood that some of the task execution capabilities of the Gemini phone assistant are implemented through GUI solutions.

Regarding the Gemini phone assistant, he mentioned that the industry refers to it as "agentic AI," but he prefers to summarize it as "getting things done." He believes that background task execution can reduce app switching and manual coordination, making processes smoother while still preserving user visibility and control. He also noted that this technology is on the rise, and the key is how to embrace it.
